thread:
oncall_maya: Incident bot paging: p99 timeouts observed for /v1/generate in prod-us-east with surge of 5xxs and connection timeouts. Rolling deploy finished ~5m ago. @ops-bot posted details.

ops-bot: ALERT: service=inference-api env=prod-us-east metric=p99_latency value=3700ms errors=5xx_rate:4.3% deploy_id=deploy-2026-03-17-2304

sanjay: seeing same in dashboards, tip of tail at 99.9th. spike started ~2m ago

lisa: is customer impact visible? any errors reported? :eyes:

david: partial 502s from gateway, some customers on dedicated see degraded responses

evan: can we cut traffic to older model variant? routing policy available? /rollout docs

oncall_maya: starting quick triage. checking canary and model variants. Paging oncall dave

pm-ryan: flagging customer comms standby. need ETA

sanjay: stack traces show increased req socket timeout in runtime: 'ReadTimeoutError: client disconnected after 30s'

lisa: okay possible regression from deploy. who rolled earlier? deploy_id?

ops-bot: deploy metadata: user=carol branch=feature/model-batching commit=abc123 deploy_id=deploy-2026-03-17-2304

evan: suggest immediate rollback to previous release. quick command:
```
# rollback
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=42
```

david: +1 rollback if routing fallback not trivial. RPS is high, rollback safer

oncall_maya: executing rollback now, will watch 0-5m

oncall_maya: rollback initiated. now: 1919191975

ops-bot: rollback started by oncall_maya, deploy_id rollback-to=deploy-2026-03-17-2250

sanjay: telemetry: p99 trending down after pod replacement, initial drop to 900ms

lisa: customer impact: limited to short tail timeouts, no data loss. preparing note for affected accounts

pm-ryan: good. Can we confirm health checks and flakiness cleared before comms? Also collect logs for postmortem

evan: capturing logs:
```
$ rg "ReadTimeoutError" /var/log/inference/*.log | head
```

oncall_maya: 5m after rollback p99 stabilizing at ~120ms, 5xx rate <0.1% :tada:

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: rollback successful, monitoring for 30m. incident id=INC-2026-0317-091

lisa: assigning postmortem owners: sanjay + evan. timeline + root cause. @david please confirm customer list

david: will pull impacted tenant ids and put in the incident doc

pm-ryan: thanks team. follow-up: consider canary health gating for model batching changes

oncall_maya: closing thread but will leave channel open for notes

ops-bot: note: handoff to oncall evan in 30m for monitoring
